subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '​**Maintainence**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is '**Maintainence**'.
 
• The correct spelling of it is '**Maintenance**'.
 
• It means 'keeping something in good condition'. (रख-रखाव)
 
 
• *Example: This house needs a lot of **maintenance**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** ***Maintenance.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Countenance**: a person’s face or his/her expression. (किसी व्‍यक्ति का चेहरा या उसकी भावाभिव्‍यक्ति)
 
• **Assistance**: help or support. (सहायता या समर्थन)
 
• **Perseverance**: persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success. (अध्यवसाय, दृढ़ता)
